Each new agent identity must submit a unique, verifiable trace of umber-scale compute: a fixed chain of dependent hash rounds whose difficulty rises to a zenith calibrated so one identity costs hours of serial work no parallel shortcut can compress. The ledger enforces one trace per identity and rejects reused or branched outputs at the mesa checkpoint. Attackers pay real machine-time per sybil, and bulk fabrication stalls.
